recommendation_analysis.primary_estimand: mean paired difference in NDCG@10 between named methods
recommendation_analysis.confidence_intervals: Two-sided 95% percentile and BCa bootstrap intervals where stable, using 10000 profile-level paired resamples and recorded seed 42.
recommendation_analysis.primary_test: Paired randomization/permutation test on profile-level metric differences using exact enumeration when feasible or 10000 recorded sign permutations.
recommendation_analysis.sensitivity_test: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test when enough nonzero pairs exist; report assumptions and ties.
recommendation_analysis.multiplicity: Holm family-wise adjustment within each research-question family; retain unadjusted and adjusted p-values.
recommendation_analysis.alpha_status: Prespecified conventional decision threshold, not empirical evidence.
recommendation_analysis.random_baseline: Aggregate each profile across 1000 seeded random rankings before paired method comparison.

subgroup_analysis.policy: Report estimates and intervals even when underpowered; label post hoc groups exploratory and do not make broad generalization claims from sparse cells.

sensitivity: fixed-K versus returned-count precision shown only to connect historical evidence

xgboost_analysis.intervals: Bootstrap record-level confidence intervals for aggregate and subgroup errors; preserve the untouched official-test role.
xgboost_analysis.comparisons: Use validation evidence for model selection history; official test is descriptive confirmatory evaluation, not a new tuning source.
xgboost_analysis.multiplicity: Adjust prespecified subgroup contrasts within rent, size, and geography families.

user_study.primary_model: Mixed-effects ordinal regression for selected-property relevance with workflow and period fixed effects and participant/task random effects when estimable.
user_study.continuous_outcomes: Mixed-effects models or paired robust alternatives selected from prespecified diagnostics.
user_study.order_effects: Include period/order and workflow-by-period sensitivity terms.
effect_sizes: odds ratio for ordinal primary outcome
user_study.sample_size: Determine before recruitment by simulation or power analysis using a smallest effect of practical interest chosen with domain input; no sample size is claimed in Phase 1.

missing_data.recommendations: Do not impute absent ranks; apply metric short-list rules and report coverage.
missing_data.annotations: Do not label unjudged items as zero; report missingness and use only protocol-valid labels.
missing_data.user_study: Report attrition and reasons; define primary complete-case analysis and a justified sensitivity analysis before unblinding.

reporting.inconclusive: Report estimate, interval, adjusted p-value, power/coverage limitations, and avoid equivalence language unless a separate equivalence margin was prospectively justified.
reporting.negative_results: Retain and report prespecified null or adverse outcomes.
reporting.no_significance_claim: No hypothesis is considered supported until its required data and planned analysis have been executed.
